selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods; identity changes in 2007 but legal status is not used as a sports-performance input.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
Guadeloupe- and France-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically into the local island identity.
No football federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
The 2007 legal-status change is represented as identity context only, not as evidence of sports participation or quality.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
